goal: Museum operator media CMS in frontend/src/app/admin/ and backend/routers/media_cms.py or history.
summary: Implemented full Museum Operator Media CMS backend and frontend for secure museum operator asset management. Features: (1) Strict file format and magic byte validation for 3D meshes (.glb) and images (.png, .jpg/.jpeg, .webp) with binary signature inspection; (2) Negative abuse security rejecting executable files (.exe, .sh), script payloads (.php, .html, .js), and disguised polyglot payloads; (3) Licensing metadata verification requiring verified rights owner (e.g. HMCC), approved license types (CC BY 4.0 / Educational Fair Use, CC0, Public Domain), and creator attribution; (4) Staged publication approval state machine (draft -> in_review -> approved -> published) blocking direct unapproved leaps; (5) Role-scoped authorization (teachers/staff can draft/submit, admins approve/publish/archive, learners/guests receive HTTP 403); (6) Automated synchronization to HistoricalAsset database catalog on publication with cryptographic SHA-256 integrity and immutable audit logging; (7) Frontend client interface at frontend/src/app/admin/media/ with upload, review, approval, rejection, and preview modals.

invariants_enforced.file_format_and_magic_byte_validation: Only GLB 3D meshes (magic header 'glTF', max 50MB) and PNG, JPEG, WEBP images (max 10MB) are accepted. File headers are verified against canonical magic bytes regardless of client-supplied headers.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_strict_rejection: Executable binaries (.exe with MZ header, ELF, shebang scripts) and script injections (.sh, .php, .html, .js, .py, etc.) as well as disguised polyglot files (.png containing <?php or <html>) are strictly rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request.
invariants_enforced.licensing_metadata_governance: Mandatory rights owner, creator attribution, and approved license (CC BY 4.0, CC BY 4.0 / Educational Fair Use, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0 1.0, Public Domain, Educational Fair Use, Museum Partner License). Unlicensed, pirated, or unauthorized entries fail immediately with HTTP 422.
invariants_enforced.staged_publication_approval_lifecycle: Enforces draft -> in_review -> approved -> published lifecycle. Direct leaps from draft or in_review to published without staged approval fail with HTTP 400 STAGED_APPROVAL_REQUIRED. Uploading replacement files increments version and resets approval status.
invariants_enforced.role_scoped_authorization: Only authorized staff/editors (STAFF_ROLES) can upload, edit metadata, and submit items for review. Approvals, rejections, publications, and archiving strictly require administrative privileges (admin/super_admin). Learners and guests receive HTTP 403 Forbidden.
invariants_enforced.historical_asset_sync_and_audit: Publication atomically generates/updates a cleared HistoricalAsset row linked via media_cms_item_id with verified SHA-256 and rights metadata, and records all transitions in historical_content_audit_log.

changes.description: Created MediaCmsItem model with publication_status check constraint, file_format check constraint, licensing metadata columns, and indices.
Created Alembic migration 0066_museum_media_cms adding media_cms_items table and historical_assets.media_cms_item_id column.
Re-exported MediaCmsItem, MediaCmsStatus, MediaCmsAssetType, and MediaCmsFileFormat.
Added media_cms_item_id mapped column to HistoricalAsset.
Defined Pydantic schemas MediaCmsItemCreate, MediaCmsItemUpdate, MediaCmsItemOut, MediaCmsItemListOut, MediaCmsReviewAction, MediaCmsPreviewOut.
Implemented core media CMS service: magic byte validation, anti-abuse security, licensing metadata validation, staged approval state machine, versioning, and HistoricalAsset synchronization.
Created FastAPI router with upload, items list, detail, update, version, submit-review, approve, reject, publish, archive, preview, and delete endpoints.

Added client API helpers for media CMS: uploadMediaCmsAsset, listMediaCmsItems, getMediaCmsItem, updateMediaCmsItem, uploadMediaCmsVersion, submitMediaCmsReview, approveMediaCmsItem, rejectMediaCmsItem, publishMediaCmsItem, archiveMediaCmsItem, getMediaCmsPreview, deleteMediaCmsItem.
Created Next.js page for Museum Operator Media CMS.
Created interactive client UI with media catalogue, filters, upload modal with client validation, review action triggers, rejection explanation modal, and 3D/2D preview.
Added Quick Action link to Museum Operator Media CMS.
Implemented 6 comprehensive test suites covering RBAC, file formats, negative abuse, licensing governance, staged approval lifecycle, versioning, preview, and audit trail.

test_details.name: test_media_cms_role_based_permissions
test_details.assertion: Verifies that unauthenticated, learner, and guest users are blocked (401/403), teachers/staff can upload and submit drafts, and only admins can approve and publish.

test_details.name: test_media_cms_file_format_and_magic_byte_validation
test_details.assertion: Verifies valid uploads for GLB meshes, PNG, JPEG, and WEBP images with correct magic byte validation, mime detection, and SHA-256 checksums.

test_details.name: test_media_cms_negative_abuse_rejected
test_details.assertion: Verifies strict rejection of executables (.exe), scripts (.sh, .php, .html), disguised/spoofed polyglot files, corrupted GLBs, and empty files with HTTP 400.

test_details.name: test_media_cms_licensing_metadata_validation
test_details.assertion: Verifies that missing rights owner, missing license, unapproved/pirated licenses, and missing attribution fail with HTTP 422, while approved licenses succeed.

test_details.name: test_media_cms_staged_publication_approval_lifecycle
test_details.assertion: Verifies draft -> in_review -> approved -> published progression, blocking direct publication skips, synchronizing to HistoricalAsset, and logging audit entries.

test_details.name: test_media_cms_rejection_and_versioning
test_details.assertion: Verifies mandatory rejection explanation, version bumping resetting approval status, operator preview configuration, and archiving restricting public display.
